messages:
maria: FYI Ledgerly (dedicated) reported p95 jump from ~120ms -> ~2.1s and ~3% 503s since the model swap at 2026-03-18 22:10 UTC. Support opened ticket #2345.
ryan: Grafana: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/abcd/ledgerly?orgId=1 — p95/error rate spike visible. Looks correlated with deploy.
alex: Any request_ids or example payloads we can trace?
maria: pasted request_id header + sample payload from support: 
```
POST /v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer ***
X-Request-ID: 2f9c3b1a
{
  "model": "redwood-v3-large",
  "prompt": "Summarize...",
  "max_tokens": 512
}
```
ops-bot: incident RED-7893 created (P1) — auto-assigned to @sumit.
sumit: I'm on it. Initial logs show a lot of queued batches and backpressure on the dedicated pool workers; KV-cache miss rate up ~4x for this model variant. Suspect batching_window_ms + new kv layout.
ryan: Can we route Ledgerly to previous model variant as a short-term rollback? That should avoid the cache layout change.
sophie: Product here — Ledgerly is contract SLO 99.9 latency. Sales says they'll escalate if this is not addressed within business hours. We need mitigation + decision: hotfix (rollback or config tweak) vs. backlog item. @ryan @alex thoughts on fastest safe option?
alex: Fastest is temporary routing to previous model or reduce batching_window_ms. Quick config snippet to reduce batching: 
```json
{
  "pool": "ledgerly-prod",
  "batching": {
    "batching_window_ms": 10,
    "max_batch_tokens": 1024
  }
}
```
ryan: I can run a route flip: `redwood routes set --customer ledgerly --model redwood-v2-512 --force` (will route new requests to previous model while we investigate).
maria: Ops/sales — want ETA if we do route flip.
sumit: Applying the reduced batching config to ledgerly-prod now (will take ~45s to propagate).
sumit: apply logs: `2026-03-19T01:05:12Z apply config ledgerly-prod batching_window_ms=10 -> success`
sumit: Observed after change: p95 dropped to ~210ms, 503s back to ~0.2%. Queues cleared.
maria: Confirmed with customer — they saw improvement. Sales team updated. :thumbsup:
sophie: Product decision: mark this P1 hotfix for rollout guardrails. Immediate action: keep temporary mitigation for 24h, then either rollback model or push a proper fix. Backlog items: (1) rollout guardrails + automated route-fallback (2) model onboarding checklist to validate kv/cache layout compatibility (3) add perf/regression test for batching effects. Create JIRA RED-7894 for guardrails.
ryan: I'll open RED-7895 to track rollback routing and tie to deployment pipeline.
alex: Also adding unit/e2e test for kv-cache warmup on model load (RED-7896).
maria: Next steps for oncall: sumit owns the hotfix mitigation and monitoring until EOD. Product: sophie owns prioritization and Jira epics. Eng-runtime: ryan+alex to follow up on routing and tests. I'll message Ledgerly with the plan.
ops-bot: Note: follow-up reminder set — 2026-03-19T10:00:00Z.
maria: closing thread for now — will reopen if we see a regression after mitigation.
